name: Video, audio & podcast editing (category)
summary: Editing video and audio, from short social clips to podcasts, as an employee or freelancer. Job Bank groups video and sound editors with audio and video recording technicians (NOC 52113).
whatYouDo: You cut raw footage or recordings into finished pieces: trimming, sequencing, adding captions, music and graphics, cleaning up sound and exporting for each platform. Freelancers often turn long videos or podcasts into short clips for social media. Employees work for production companies, broadcasters, recording studios and post-production houses.
appeal: Job Bank lists a national median of about $30/hour for videotape editors (NOC 52113), with a range of about $20–$46
Project-based work, much of which can be done remotely
Skills carry over to social media, captioning and podcast production, so one skill set serves several kinds of clients
Film editors (NOC 51120) have a higher Job Bank median of about $38.94/hour, showing a progression route
watchOuts: Job Bank wage figures for videotape editors were last updated November 2023 and may be dated
Job Bank's 2025–2027 outlook for NOC 52113 is Limited in most regions and Very limited in Ontario and Montréal
Job Bank says employee roles usually need a college diploma or 2+ years of apprenticeship. Film editor roles usually need a university degree
Podcast producer jobs found asked for a lot of experience (one Scotiabank posting required 5+ years of podcast, broadcast or similar production)
You need a capable computer and editing software. Their cost was not researched
Freelance demand is irregular, with no guaranteed volume

credentials: College diploma or 2+ year apprenticeship usually expected for employee roles (Job Bank)

training.notes: Job Bank: employee roles usually expect a college program (e.g. recording engineering or audiovisual technology) or apprenticeship. Freelancers often self-teach; course costs not researched.

compensation.notes: Job Bank 'Editor, Videotape' (NOC 52113) Canada wage table per search summary: low $20.00, median $30.00, high $46.15 per hour, last updated 29 Nov 2023. Employee wages, not freelance rates. A remote audio producer/editor contract posting on Podnews listed $50–70K a year (currency not stated). Freelance per-project rates were not researched.

reliability.notes: Job Bank outlook for NOC 52113 (2025–2027): Limited in most regions, Very limited in Ontario and Montréal, Moderate in Centre-du-Québec. Few openings expected from retirements. Freelance volume depends on clients.

applicationSteps: Learn a video and/or audio editor and make 3–5 sample edits, such as turning a long video or podcast into short clips
Offer services to local creators, small businesses and podcasters, or through general freelance platforms
For employee roles, search Job Bank for videotape editor, post-production technician and sound effects editor titles
Consider a college program in broadcasting or audiovisual technology if you're aiming for studio or broadcaster jobs
fitsIf: You like detailed, creative computer work and can teach yourself editing tools and build a sample reel.
notFitIf: You need steady hours right away or can't invest in a capable computer and software.
